contexts.text: It shall not be numbered for multitude () = multiplication beyond measure.
Thou shalt be the father of a multitude of nations () = the union of the Human Essence with the Divine Essence... Multitude = truth. AC 2006.
The reason multitude = truth, is that to be multiplied is predicated of truth.
The multitude of the sea () = the immense (or unmeasured) abundance of natural truth.

A troop, here, is a multitude; and, when a multitude is predicated of the Divine of the Lord, it is an infinite multitude, which is nothing else than omnipotence and omniscience; but omnipotence is predicated from the quantity which is of magnitude; and omniscience, from the quantity which is of multitude...
It hath broken forth to a multitude () = fecundity afterwards... namely, after it was conjoined.
A congregation, and a multitude, in the Word, are predicated of truths.
For in a unanimous multitude there is strength.
Under Multiply, see this reference.
Let them grow to a multitude in the midst of the earth () = extension from the inmost... For the truths, which are signified by a multitude. extend themselves from the inmost... round about.
In that region (of Jupiter) there is as great a multitude of men as the Earth can nourish.
In the multitude of Thine excellence () = the Divine as to power over those things which oppose themselves to Him.
How immense already is the multitude of men (in the Spiritual World), it has sometimes been granted me to see...
The multitude of such. Signified.
I was once in amazement at the vast multitude of men who ascribe creation to nature... TCR 35.
Concerning the multitude of Spirits who concur to a single action of man.
By the multitude of waters in the heavens () are signified truths in abundance. AE 644:19.
Hence it is that much, and multitude, in the Word, are said of truths; and great, and magnitude, of good...
That there is no truth, is signified by, Its multitude is dry with thirst ()... multitude, in the Word, is predicated of truths.
The multitude of the city () = all the truths of doctrine... Multitude is said of truths.
The great multitude (of Moab) () = falsities from evil.
The voice of a multitude in the mountains () = falsities from evils; multitude = falsities; and mountains, evils.
The falsities of evil are signified by the multitude of iniquity ().
The multitude (of Pharaoh) () = all the Scientific there.
The falsities of evil fighting against the goods of the Church, are signified by, the multitude of all the nations fighting against Mount Zion (). Multitude is predicated of truths.
